principles: Fusion over Imitation: Cinematic + Tech + Glass
Emotion First: The UI must feel 'Alive' and 'Magical'
Content is King: The user's video is the hero
Zoom In: Focus on the canvas
Negative Space: Give the tools breathing room
Contrast: Deep blacks vs Neon glows

secondary_font.name: Manrope
secondary_font.usage: Body text, UI elements, Inputs, Tooltips

glow_effects.strategy: Use box-shadow matching the active category color

nebula_background.strategy: Use the nebula image as a fixed background with overlay
nebula_background.css: background-image: url('IMAGE_URL'); background-size: cover; background-attachment: fixed;

landing_page.hero: Centered, large typography, nebula background visible, category grid below
landing_page.sections: Alternating grid layouts, glass cards for features

creator_card.style: Floating glass panel, centered or asymmetrical overlay
creator_card.form_elements: Transparent inputs with bottom borders or glass backgrounds

buttons.style: Pill-shaped or sharp depending on context
buttons.primary: Gradient background matching category, white text
buttons.secondary: Glass background, white border, hover glow

nebula_bg.description: Primary background for Hero and Landing page

abstract_glass.description: Decorative element for feature sections or empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. UPDATE `tailwind.config.js`: Add 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' to fontFamily. Add the custom colors to the theme extend.
2. UPDATE `index.css`: Import the fonts at the top. Set global dark theme styles.
3. IMPLEMENT `CategoryContext`: Create a React Context to manage the currently selected category and its color. This color should cascade to buttons, borders, and glows.
4. COMPONENT OVERRIDES: Customize Shadcn components (Button, Input, Card) to use the Glassmorphism styles defined in `visual_enhancers`.
5. EDITOR LAYOUT: Use a CSS Grid layout for the editor. Sidebar (250px), Properties (300px), Timeline (300px height), Canvas (remaining).
6. ANIMATIONS: Use Framer Motion for page transitions and the 'Creator Card' appearance. Keyframe the Nebula background if possible (slow pan/zoom).
7. DATA-TESTID: Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`
